'''Bernhard Wilhelm Roth''' (born 13 November 1970) is a German [[experimental physics|experimental physicist]].

== Scientific career ==
From 1992 to 1997 Roth studied physics at [[Bielefeld University]] from where he obtained his diploma in physics. He received his [[doctoral degree]] (Dr. rer. nat.) in the field of atomic and particle physics at Bielefeld University.<ref>Atomic and particle physics group [https://www.physik.uni-bielefeld.de/experi/d1/baum/d1people.html "Atomic and particle physics group"], Retrieved on 23 October 2018.</ref> From 2002 to 2007 he worked as assistant professor and group leader in experimental [[quantum optics]] at the Institute for Experimental Physics, Quantum Optics and Relativity Group<ref>Institute for Experimental Physics [http://www.exphy.uni-duesseldorf.de/PhotosMembers/Roth.html "Institute for Experimental Physics"] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110311014747/http://www.exphy.uni-duesseldorf.de/PhotosMembers/Roth.html |date=2011-03-11 }}, Retrieved on 23 March 2018.</ref> at [[Heinrich Heine University Düsseldorf]]. In 2007 Roth obtained his state doctorate ([[Habilitation]]) in [[experimental physics]] in the field of production and spectroscopy on ultracold molecular ions<ref>Habilitation Thesis Bernhard Wilhelm Roth [https://docserv.uni-duesseldorf.de/servlets/DocumentServlet?id=6583 "Habilitation Thesis"], ''[[Heinrich Heine University Düsseldorf]]'', Retrieved on 23 March 2018.</ref> at Heinrich Heine University Düsseldorf. From 2007 to 2010 he was [[associate professor]] and group leader at the Institute for Experimental Physics at Heinrich Heine University Düsseldorf and from 2011 to 2012 center manager at the Centre for Innovation Competence innoFSPEC Potsdam<ref>innoFSPEC Potsdam [https://www.innofspec.de/ " innovation centre in optical fibre spectroscopy and sensing"], ''[[Leibniz Institute for Astrophysics Potsdam]]'', Retrieved on 23 March 2018.</ref> of the [[Leibniz Institute for Astrophysics Potsdam]] (AIP)<ref>Leibniz Institute for Astrophysics Potsdam [http://www.aip.de/en?set_language=en"], ''[[Leibniz Institute for Astrophysics Potsdam]]'', Retrieved on 23 March 2018.</ref> and the [[University of Potsdam]].<ref>University Potsdam, Physical Chemistry UPPC [https://www.chem.uni-potsdam.de/groups/pc/index_en.htm], ''[[University of Potsdam]]'', Retrieved on 23 March 2018.</ref> Since 2012 he is scientific and managing director of the Hannover Centre for Optical Technologies HOT,<ref>Hannover Centre for Optical Technologies HOT [https://www.hot.uni-hannover.de/ "Hannover Centre for Optical Technologies HOT"], ''[[Leibniz University Hannover]]'', Retrieved on 04 January 2019.</ref> an interdisciplinary research centre at [[Leibniz University Hannover]]. In 2012 Roth also obtained his state doctorate in physics at Leibniz University Hannover and in 2014 he was appointed [[professor]] in physics at the Faculty of Mathematics and Physics of Leibniz University Hannover, see also.<ref>Bernhard Wilhelm Roth [[:de:Bernhard Wilhelm Roth|„Bernhard Wilhelm Roth“]], Retrieved on 03 April 2019.{{Circular reference|date=December 2019}}</ref> As director of HOT he is one of the coordinators of the International Master Program Optical Technologies: Photonics and Laser Technology (M.Sc.) at Leibniz University Hannover.<ref>Master Program Optical Technologies [https://www.daad.de/deutschland/studienangebote/international-programmes/en/?p=d&s=kr&id=4656 "International Programmes in Germany"], ''[[German Academic Exchange Service|DAAD]]'', Retrieved on 23 March 2018.</ref><ref>Bundesagentur für Arbeit, BerufeNet/BerufeTV Optische Technologien [https://berufenet.arbeitsagentur.de/berufenet/faces/index;BERUFENETJSESSIONID=PuahqvU1vovIDHdw7ov02rkzdprIcXfZFG60YUAy1t13iSEu4j6V!243852619?path=null/kurzbeschreibung/filmueberdasstudiumzumzur&dkz=93641 "Bundesagentur für Arbeit, BerufeNet/BerufeTV Optische Technologien"], Retrieved on 23 October 2018.</ref>

== Research ==
The scientific activities of B. Roth are focused on applied and fundamental research in [[optics]] and [[photonics]]. This includes the development of integrated functional photonics and polymer-optical sensing, e.g., based on fibre-optic or planar concepts, [[laser spectroscopy]], optofluidics, and analytics in the [[life sciences]], optical technologies for multimodal imaging in medicine, information and illumination technology as well as [[digital holography]]. Furthermore, hybrid multi-physics and multi-scale numerical simulations for complex optical systems and algorithms for simulation inversion are investigated. Initial research fields include [[quantum optics]] and [[laser spectroscopy]], in particular [[laser cooling]] of trapped atomic and molecular ions and high-precision laser spectroscopy of ultracold molecular ions, as well as low-energy atomic and particle physics.<ref>List of Publications of Prof. Dr. Bernhard Roth [https://www.hot.uni-hannover.de/de/roth/publikationsliste/ "List of Publications of Prof. Dr. Bernhard Roth"], Retrieved on 23 October 2018.</ref><ref>google scholar profile of Prof.Dr. Bernhard Roth [https://scholar.google.de/citations?user=kgO9pJAAAAAJ&hl=de&oi=ao "google scholar profile of Prof.Dr. Bernhard Roth"], Retrieved on 23 October 2018.</ref> Roth is member of the Collaborative Research Center PlanOS - Planar optronic systems<ref>PlanOS [https://www.planos.uni-hannover.de/institut.html?&L=1 "PlanOS"], Retrieved on 23 October 2018.</ref> applicant team,<ref>PlanOS Team [https://www.planos.uni-hannover.de/personen.html?&L=1 "PlanOS Team"], Retrieved on 23 October 2018.</ref><ref>youtube video PlanOS vision [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lDIg42HflFI "youtube video PlanOS vision"], Retrieved on 23 October 2018.</ref> and one of the principal investigators (PI) in the Cluster of Excellence PhoenixD: Photonics, Optics, Engineering - Innovation Across Disciplines<ref>PhoenixD [https://www.phoenixd.uni-hannover.de/de/struktur/team/#c899 "PhoenixD"] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181113211438/https://www.phoenixd.uni-hannover.de/de/struktur/team/#c899 |date=2018-11-13 }}, Retrieved on 23 October 2018.</ref> of the German Research Foundation DFG,<ref>List of the approved Clusters of Excellence [https://www.dfg.de/download/pdf/foerderung/programme/exzellenzstrategie/exstra_entscheidung_exc_180927_en.pdf "List of the approved Clusters of Excellence"] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190403153021/https://www.dfg.de/download/pdf/foerderung/programme/exzellenzstrategie/exstra_entscheidung_exc_180927_en.pdf |date=2019-04-03 }}, Retrieved on 23 October 2018.</ref><ref>List of the approved Clusters of Excellence [https://www.dfg.de/resource/blob/357410/a36b3cdbee8d784f872acf5bcba494cd/250522-exstra-list-map-exc-data.pdf „List of the approved Clusters of Excellence“], Retrieved on 19 June 2025.</ref> which explores the possibilities of digitalization for novel optical and photonic systems as well as their production and application.

== Awards ==
Roth is recipient of the prestigious Kaiser-Friedrich Forschungspreis 2018 (Kaiser-Friedrich Research Award 2018) for Photonic Technologies for the Digital Laboratory <ref>Kaiser-Friedrich-Forschungspreis 2018 [http://kaiserfriedrichforschungspreis.de/ "Kaiser-Friedrich-Forschungspreis 2018"], Retrieved on 23 October 2018.</ref> for the project SmartSens<ref>SmartSens Kurzbeschreibung [http://kaiserfriedrichforschungspreis.de/wp-content/uploads/2018/10/Kurzfassung_SmartSens.pdf "SmartSens Kurzbeschreibung"], Retrieved on 23 October 2018.</ref> together with Dr. Johanna-Gabriela Walter (TCI, Leibniz University Hannover)<ref>Dr. Johanna-Gabriela Walter [https://www.tci.uni-hannover.de/walter.html?&L=1 "Dr. Johanna-Gabriela Walter"], Retrieved on 23 October 2018.</ref> and Dr. Kort Bremer (HOT, Leibniz University Hannover).<ref>Dr. Kort Bremer [https://www.hot.uni-hannover.de/533.html?&no_cache=1&tx_tkinstpersonen_pi1%5Balias%5D=kortbremer "Dr. Kort Bremer"] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181113211428/https://www.hot.uni-hannover.de/533.html?&no_cache=1&tx_tkinstpersonen_pi1%5Balias%5D=kortbremer |date=2018-11-13 }}, Retrieved on 23 October 2018.</ref><ref>Preisträger des Kaiser-Friedrich-Forschungspreises 2018 [http://kaiserfriedrichforschungspreis.de/preistraeger-2018-2/ "Preisträger des Kaiser-Friedrich-Forschungspreises 2018"], Retrieved on 23 October 2018.</ref> The prize was awarded for the development of novel smartphone-based optical sensing for medicine and the life sciences.

In 2021, Roth received the Kaiser-Friedrich Forschungspreis 2020 (Kaiser-Friedrich Research Award 2020) for Photonic Technologies in Environmental and Climate Protection <ref>Renommierter Kaiser-Friedrich-Forschungspreis an Team der Leibniz Universität Hannover verliehen [https://idw-online.de/de/news781531 "Kaiser Friedrich Forschungspreis 2020, awarded on 24 November 2021"], retrieved on 01 December 2021.</ref> together with Dr. Ann-Kathrin Kniggendorf (HOT, Leibniz University Hannover) for the project OPTIMUS.<ref>Wissenschaftlerinnen und Wissenschaftler entwickeln innovatives Verfahren zum Aufspüren von Mikroplastik in Trinkwasser [https://www.uni-hannover.de/de/universitaet/aktuelles/online-aktuell/details/news/renommierter-kaiser-friedrich-forschungspreis-an-team-der-leibniz-universitaet-hannover-verliehen/ „Kaiser-Friedrich-Forschungspreis an Team der Leibniz Universität Hannover, awarded on 24 November 2021“], retrieved 01 December 2021.</ref> The prize was awarded for the development of new optical systems for the online-detection of [[microplastics]] in the environment.

In 2024 Roth, together with an interdisciplinary team from physics and medicine at Leibniz University Hannover (group headed by Prof. Dr. Bernhard Roth) and the University Medical Centre Rostock (group headed by Prof. Dr. Steffen Emmert), received the prestigious Helmholtz Prize in the field of Applied Metrology for innovations in optical biopsy for skin cancer diagnostics <ref>Precision that excels: Helmholtz Prizes awarded to research groups from Konstanz, Hannover and Rostock [https://www.ptb.de/cms/en/presseaktuelles/journalisten/news-press-releases/press-release.html?tx_news_pi1%5Bnews%5D=13832&tx_news_pi1%5Bcontroller%5D=News&tx_news_pi1%5Baction%5D=detail&tx_news_pi1%5Bday%5D=3&tx_news_pi1%5Bmonth%5D=6&tx_news_pi1%5Byear%5D=2024&cHash=b780ed46aa66cc85d8c81a8d4311f838%2F "Pecision measurements honored with Helmholtz Prize 2024"], retrieved 13 June 2024.</ref><ref>Helmholtz Prize for development of new method for diagnosing skin cancer [https://www.uni-hannover.de/en/universitaet/aktuelles/online-aktuell/details/news/helmholtz-preis-fuer-die-entwicklung-neuartiger-hautkrebsdiagnostik/ „Helmholtz Prize awarded for skin cancer diagnostics“], retrieved 13 June 2024.</ref> The team developed a novel multimodal system for in vivo detection of skin cancer and validated its functionality in clinical measurements.
